# sonrai_organization_policies (Data Source)

Lists the organization policies Sonrai knows of in an AWS organization: the ones written in Sonrai, and the service control and resource control policies it discovered in AWS.

Use it to see what exists before defining one with `sonrai_organization_policy`, which rejects a name a managed policy already has, to find the id to import, and to see where a policy is attached before destroying it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every organization policy Sonrai knows of in the AWS organization: the ones
# written in Sonrai, and the SCPs and RCPs it discovered in AWS.
data "sonrai_organization_policies" "all" {
  root_scope = "aws/r-abcd"
}

# The ones Sonrai deploys, with where each is attached.
output "managed_policies" {
  value = {
    for p in data.sonrai_organization_policies.all.policies : p.name => {
      id          = p.id
      policy_type = p.policy_type
      # Ids to give sonrai_organization_policy_attachment as resource_id.
      attached_to = p.attached_resource_ids
    }
    if p.managed
  }
}

# Policies still attached by AWS itself, which Sonrai only reports on.
output "unmanaged_policies" {
  value = [for p in data.sonrai_organization_policies.all.policies : p.name if !p.managed]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `root_scope` (String) Root scope of the AWS organization, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `root_scope`.
- `policies` (Attributes List) Every policy, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `attached_resource_ids` (List of String) Cloud-native id of each entry in `attached_scopes`, in the same order: what `sonrai_organization_policy_attachment` takes as `resource_id`.
- `attached_scopes` (List of String) Scope paths the policy is attached at: for a managed policy, where Sonrai has deployed it; for an unmanaged one, where AWS attaches it. An attachment that is staged and not yet deployed is not listed.
- `authored` (Boolean) True for a policy written in Sonrai, false for one discovered in AWS. Only authored policies can be imported into `sonrai_organization_policy`.
- `content` (String) The policy document, as compact JSON.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Sonrai's id for the policy. For a managed policy, this is what `sonrai_organization_policy` imports and `sonrai_organization_policy_attachment` takes as `policy_id`.
- `managed` (Boolean) True when Sonrai deploys the policy. A discovered policy that is not managed is only reported here; AWS still attaches it.
- `name` (String)
- `policy_type` (String) `SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY` or `RESOURCE_CONTROL_POLICY`.
